title: Ok for greenery
text: Ok for greenery. The greenery parts of this arrangement are pretty but the roses are very fake looking. I used the greenery from this set with some more realistic looking fake roses and it make a very pretty bouquet for staging my house. Overall, its just ok. I wouldn't use it on its own but it's pretty to add to other flowers.

What could be more delicate and whimsical than the baby’s breath?  Gypsophila has long been a favorite at weddings and other special events, there’s no limit to all the amazing things you can do with baby’s breath flowers, it makes the perfect flower crowns for bridesmaids and flower girls, and adds an ethereal look to bouquets and centerpieces. The eucalyptus leaves add a natural feeling to make the whole flower arrangement more realistic.

The artificial greenery plant is a great idea for people who loves having greenery around but not good at keeping plants alive. Artificial flower arrangements can be used to decorate your plant's pots, different style vases, flower baskets. An environment that includes natural elements and plants boosts people into feeling alive and active.
Do these have a strong smell?
They have some smell, because it is made of plastic. One or two days, the smell will gone.
